# MARS { #wass2s.MARS }

```python
MARS(max_terms=21, max_degree=2, penalty=3.0, min_span=5)
```

Multivariate Adaptive Regression Splines with corrected forward/backward passes.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [backward_pass](#wass2s.MARS.backward_pass) | Backward pass to prune basis functions. |
| [fit](#wass2s.MARS.fit) | Fit MARS model. |
| [forward_pass](#wass2s.MARS.forward_pass) | Forward pass to add basis functions. |
| [get_formula](#wass2s.MARS.get_formula) | Get human-readable formula for the model. |
| [predict](#wass2s.MARS.predict) | Predict using fitted MARS model. |

### backward_pass { #wass2s.MARS.backward_pass }

```python
MARS.backward_pass(X, y, B, beta)
```

Backward pass to prune basis functions.

### fit { #wass2s.MARS.fit }

```python
MARS.fit(X, y)
```

Fit MARS model.

### forward_pass { #wass2s.MARS.forward_pass }

```python
MARS.forward_pass(X, y)
```

Forward pass to add basis functions.

### get_formula { #wass2s.MARS.get_formula }

```python
MARS.get_formula(feature_names=None)
```

Get human-readable formula for the model.

### predict { #wass2s.MARS.predict }

```python
MARS.predict(X)
```

Predict using fitted MARS model.
